en.title: Message by Minister of Foreign Affairs H.E. Abdulla Shahid on the occasion of the Commonwealth Day
en.description: MESSAGE BY HIS EXCELLENCY ABDULLA SHAHID, MINISTER OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS ON THE OCCASION OF COMMONWEALTH DAY
en.body:
MESSAGE BY HIS EXCELLENCY ABDULLA SHAHID, MINISTER OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS ON THE OCCASION OF COMMONWEALTH DAY

"Today, on Commonwealth Day, we join all Commonwealth members, spanning the globe, to celebrate cultural diversity, friendship and the values that bind us. It is a day to reflect on the progress we have made and celebrate our people who have made it possible. This is also the time to weigh up on what more we can do to realize our vision to advance our shared priorities.

COVID-19 has brought a number of economic issues to the forefront and revealed our shared fragility. It brought with it a new set of challenges, but it also presented us with many opportunities. With the economic recovery underway, the need for more resilient and sustainable growth is greater. This year’s theme demonstrates the many levels at which we need cooperation to ensure that we achieve our shared goals.

Commonwealth-Maldives relations have been wide-ranging and prosperous. It has grown to adapt well to our foreign policy priorities over the decades. Our people are deeply appreciative of the opportunities we receive, particularly in the fields of environment, education, technology, and sports. Our joint efforts in echoing and championing the voice and needs of SIDS is fundamental as well.

We are proud to have re-joined this family. As the Commonwealth continues to serve as a beacon of hope for many, we look forward to enhancing our partnership in finding solutions to our shared challenges through collective action. In light of this, we reaffirm our commitment to work with the Commonwealth to uphold and work together in ‘Delivering a Common Future'."

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Mauritius
en.description: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Mauritius
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Mauritius

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sends a message of felicitations to the Minister for Foreign Affairs, Regional Integration and International Trade and Minister for Land Transport and Light Rail of Mauritius, Alan Ganoo, on the occasion of the Independence Day of the Republic of Mauritius.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“Excellency,

Let me extend warm felicitations and good wishes to Your Excellency, the Government and the friendly people of Mauritius, on the joyous occasion of your Independence Day.

I am confident that the bonds of friendship between our two island nations will continue to develop and flourish in the years ahead.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

dv.title: އެމެރިކާ ސަރުކާރުގެ އިސް ބައެއް ފަރާތްތަކާ ސްޓޭޓް މިނިސްޓަރ ޚަލީލް ބައްދަލުކުރައްވައިފި
dv.description: އެމެރިކާ ސަރުކާރުގެ އިސް ބައެއް ފަރާތްތަކާ ސްޓޭޓް މިނިސްޓަރ ޚަލީލް ބައްދަލުކުރައްވައިފި
dv.body:
އެމެރިކާ ސަރުކާރުގެ އިސް ބައެއް ފަރާތްތަކާ ސްޓޭޓް މިނިސްޓަރ ޚަލީލް ބައްދަލުކުރައްވައިފި

އެމެރިކާގެ ސްޓޭޓް ޑިޕާޓްމަންޓްގެ ދެކުނު އަދި މެދުތެރޭ އޭޝިއާއާއި ބެހޭ އެންމެ އިސްވެރިޔާ، އެސިސްޓަންޓް ސެކްރެޓަރީ އޮފް ސްޓޭޓް ޑޮނަލްޑް ލޫ އާއި މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް ސްޓޭޓް ފޮރ ފޮރިން އެފެއަރޒް އަހުމަދު ޚަލީލް މިއަދު އެމެރިކާގެ ވެރިރަށް ވޮޝިންޓަން ޑީސީ ގައި ބައްދަލުކުރައްވައިފިއެވެ. މީގެ އިތުރުން ޔޫ.އެސް އޭޖެންސީ ފޮރ އިންޓަނޭޝަނަލް އެއިޑް (ޔޫ.އެސް އޭ.އައި.ޑީ)ގެ ދެކުނު އިރުމަތީ އޭޝިއާ ސަރަހައްދުގެ ކަންތަކާ ހަވާލުވެ ހުންނެވި އެކްޓިންގ ޑެޕިއުޓީ އެސިސްޓަންޓް އެޑްމިނިސްޓްރޭޓަރ ތިއޮޑޯރާ ޑެލް އާއިއެކުވެސް ސްޓޭޓް މިނިސްޓަރ ޚަލީލު ވަނީ ބައްދަލުކުރައްވާފައެވެ.

އެމެރިކާގެ އެސިސްޓަންޓް ސެކްރެޓަރީ އޮފް ސްޓޭޓް ޑޮނަލްޑް ލޫ އާއިއެކު ބޭއްވެވި މަޝްވަރާތަކުގައި ދެ ބޭފުޅުން ވަނީ އެމެރިކާއާއި ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއާ ދެމެދު އޮތް ޒަމާންވީ ގާތް ގުޅުމާ ބެހޭ ގޮތުން މަޝްވަރާކުރައްވާފައެވެ. އަދި ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގައި އެމެރިކާގެ އެމްބަސީއެއް ޤާއިމްކުރުމަށް ކުރެވޭ މަސައްކަތްތަކާ ބެހޭ ގޮތުން ދެ ބޭފުޅުން މަޝްވަރާކުރެއްވިއެވެ. އަދި ތައުލީމާއި، ތިމާވެށި އަދި މޫސުމީ ބަދަލުތަކާ ގުޅޭ ގޮތުން އިތުރަށް ގުޅުން ބަދަހިކުރުމާއި، ބައިނަލްއަޤްވާމީ މަސްރަހުގައި ހިނގާ ދެޤައުމާ ގުޅުން ހުރި ކަންތައްތަކާ ބެހޭ ގޮތުން ސްޓޭޓް މިނިސްޓަރ ޚަލީލު އާއި އެސިސްޓަންޓް ސެކްރެޓަރީ ލޫ މަޝްވަރާކުރެއްވިއެވެ.

ޔޫ.އެސް.އޭ.އައި.ޑީ އާއެކު ސްޓޭޓް މިނިސްޓަރ ޚަލީލް ކުރެއްވި މަޝްވަރާތަކުގައި އެ އޭޖެންސީގެ އެހީތެރިކަމާއެކު ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގައި މިހާރު ހިންގަމުންދާ އެކިއެކި ޕްރޮޖެކްޓްތަކާ ބެހޭ ގޮތުން މަޝްވަރާކުރެއްވިއެވެ.

ސްޓޭޓް މިނިސްޓަރ ޚަލީލްގެ އަރިހުގައި ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއިން އެމެރިކާއަށް ކަނޑައަޅާފައި ހުންނަވާ ސަފީރު ތިލްމީޒާ ހުސެންއާއި، އެމްބަސީގެ މިނިސްޓަރ-ކައުންސެލަރ ހަސަން އާދަމްގެ އިތުރުން މިނިސްޓްރީ އޮފް ފޮރިން އެފެއަރޒްގެ ޖޮއިންޓް ސެކްރެޓަރީ ޝިއުނީން ރަޝީދު އާއި ކޮމިއުނިކޭޝަން ޑިރެކްޓަރ މިއުވާން މުހައްމަދު ބައިވެރިވެވަޑައިގަތެވެ.

en.title: State Minister Ahmed Khaleel meets the US Assistant Secretary of State and the Acting Deputy Assistant Administrator for South and Central Asia at USAID
en.description: State Minister Ahmed Khaleel meets the US Assistant Secretary of State and the Acting Deputy Assistant Administrator for South and Central Asia at USAID
en.body:
State Minister Ahmed Khaleel meets the US Assistant Secretary of State and the Acting Deputy Assistant Administrator for South and Central Asia at USAID

Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Ahmed Khaleel meets the Assistant Secretary of State for the Bureau of South and Central Asian Affairs of the United States Department of State, Donald Lu, and the Acting Deputy Assistant Administrator for South and Central Asia at USAID, Theodora Dell, during his visit to Washington D. C. today.

State Minister Khaleel and Assistant Secretary of State Lu discussed on enhancing the traditionally close bilateral partnership and global matters of mutual importance. This include, the establishment of a resident US Embassy, as well as expanding cooperation in the fields of education, environment and climate change and economic cooperation. State Minister and Assistant Secretary Lu also discussed global matters of mutual importance.

During the meeting with Acting Deputy Assistant Administrator Theodora Dell, State Minister Khaleel noted the significant role played by USAID to improve resilience of individuals and communities in the Maldives. State Minister Khaleel and Acting Deputy Assistant Administrator Dell also reviewed the ongoing cooperation programmes by USAID in the Maldives.

State Minister Ahmed Khaleel was accompanied by Ambassador of Maldives to the United States of America, Thilmeeza Hussain, Joint Secretary, Shiuneen Rasheed, Minister – Counsellor at the Embassy of Maldives in New York, Hassan Adam and Miuvan Mohamed, Communications Director.

en.title: Joint Press Statement of the 5th NSA Level Meeting of the Colombo Security Conclave held on 09 – 10 March 2022, in Maldives
en.description: Joint Press Statement of the 5th NSA Level Meeting of the Colombo Security Conclave held on 09 – 10 March 2022, in Maldives
en.body:
Joint Press Statement of the 5th NSA Level Meeting of the Colombo Security Conclave held on 09 – 10 March 2022, in Maldives

Delegations of the founding members of Colombo Security Conclave; Maldives, India and Sri Lanka, and the newest member of the Conclave, Mauritius, successfully concluded the 5th National Security Adviser level meeting held on 09 – 10 March 2022 in Maldives. Delegations from Bangladesh and Seychelles participated as Observers.

Their Excellencies, Mariya Ahmed Didi, Minister of Defence of the Republic of Maldives; Mr. Ajit Doval, KC, National Security Adviser to the Prime Minister of Republic of India; General Kamal Gunaratne (Retd.), Secretary to the Ministry of Defence of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka; and Mr. Kumaresan Ilango, National Security Adviser to the Republic of Mauritius, identified key areas of cooperation to enhance and strengthen regional security in the following five pillars:

• Maritime Safety and Security

• Countering Terrorism and Radicalisation

• Combating Trafficking and Transnational Organised Crime

• Cyber Security, Protection of Critical Infrastructure and Technology

• Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief

The Member states agreed upon a roadmap for further cooperation and collaboration on these pillars of cooperation. The roadmap will facilitate robust mechanisms for coordinated responses capacity building and strengthening information flow between member states.

Delegation from Bangladesh was led by H.E. Tarique Ahmed Siddique, Defence and Security Adviser to the Prime Minister of Bangladesh and Seychelles was represented by H.E. Simon Archange Dine, Chief of Staff of Seychelles Defence Forces.

As maritime neighbours, facing similar threats, the Conclave reaffirmed their commitment to engage in consistent joint efforts to achieving regional peace and security.

en.title: Non-Resident High Commissioner of Maldives to New Zealand presents his Credentials
en.description: Non-Resident High Commissioner of Maldives to New Zealand presents his Credentials
en.body:
Non-Resident High Commissioner of Maldives to New Zealand presents his Credentials

The Non-Resident High Commissioner of Republic of Maldives to New Zealand, His Excellency Ibrahim Shaheeb, presented his Letter of Credence to the Governor General and Commander-in-Chief of New Zealand, Her Excellency The Right Honorable Dame Cindy Kiro, GNZM, QSO at a ceremony held virtually this morning.

During the virtual courtesy call following the Credential Ceremony, Governor General of New Zealand congratulated High Commissioner Shaheeb on assumption of his duties as the Non-Resident High Commissioner of Maldives to New Zealand and reaffirmed the commitment of the New Zealand Government to further strengthening the bilateral relations between the two countries.

High Commissioner Shaheeb expressed his gratitude for being given the honour to present his Letter of Credence and serve as the Non-Resident High Commissioner of Maldives to New Zealand. High Commissioner Shaheeb also conveyed greetings from His Excellency President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih and the people of Maldives to the Governor General, and People of New Zealand. High Commissioner Shaheeb further expressed his commitment to work closely with the New Zealand Government in further strengthening the existing bilateral and multilateral cooperation between the two countries.

High Commissioner Shaheeb was accompanied at the virtual ceremony by his spouse Mariyam Ilham Niyaz and Deputy High Commissioner of Maldives to Singapore, Eman Hussain.

en.title: Non-Resident Ambassador of Maldives to Viet Nam presents Credentials to the President of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam
en.description: Non-Resident Ambassador of Maldives to Viet Nam presents Credentials to the President of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam
en.body:
Non-Resident Ambassador of Maldives to Viet Nam presents Credentials to the President of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam

The Non- Resident Ambassador of Republic of Maldives to the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam, His Excellency Mohamed Jinah presented his Letter of Credence to the President of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam His Excellency Mr. Nguyen Xuan Phuc, at a ceremony held this afternoon at the Presidential Palace, Hanoi.

During the brief courtesy call following the ceremony, Ambassador Jinah expressed his gratitude for being given the honour to present his Letter of Credence and to serve as the Non-Resident Ambassador of Maldives to Viet Nam. Ambassador Jinah also conveyed greetings from His Excellency President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih and the people of Maldives, to the President and People of Viet Nam. Ambassador Jinah further expressed the commitment to work closely with the Vietnamese Government with a renewed focus in enhancing the bilateral relationship, and on focusing in the areas of promoting tourism, trade and other areas of mutual interest. The President of Viet Nam congratulated Ambassador Jinah on the assumption of his duties as Non-Resident Ambassador of Maldives to Viet Nam and expressed hope to work closely with the Maldives in further strengthening the relations and increase people to people to contact between the two countries.

During his visit to Viet Nam, Ambassador Jinah will pay a courtesy call on His Excellency Mr. Bui Thanh Son, Minister of Foreign Affairs of Viet Nam. He will also be meeting with senior officials from the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, Ministry of Labor, Invalids and Social Affairs and Civil Aviation Authority of Viet Nam to discuss further on exploring opportunities and enhancing the cooperation between the two countries.

en.title: The New Ambassador of Maldives to Nepal Presents Credentials to the President of Nepal
en.description: The New Ambassador of Maldives to Nepal Presents Credentials to the President of Nepal
en.body:
The New Ambassador of Maldives to Nepal Presents Credentials to the President of Nepal

Kathamandu, March 02, 2022: The new Non-Resident Ambassador of Maldives to Nepal, His Excellency Dr. Hussain Niyaaz, presented his Letter of Credence to Her Excellency Mrs Bidya Devi Bhandari, President of Nepal, at a ceremony held at the Office of the President of Nepal - Rashtrapati Bhawan, this afternoon.

During the ceremony, President Mrs Bidya Devi Bhandari congratulated Ambassador Niyaaz on his appointment and expressed confidence that the Ambassador will work to reinforce the close ties between Maldives and Nepal. Ambassador Dr. Niyaaz conveyed greetings and good wishes from His Excellency President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih and the people of the Republic of Maldives to the Government and the friendly people of Nepal.

Ambassador Dr. Niyaaz expressed sincere appreciation on behalf of the Government and the people of the Maldives for the continued assistance from Nepal in the socio-economic development, in particular in the health sector of the Maldives. As the newly accredited Ambassador, Dr. Niyaaz assured his commitment to work closely with the Government of Nepal to further strengthen the close relations between the two countries in areas of mutual interest, during his tenure.

Following the presentation ceremony, Ambassador Dr. Niyaaz will also call on Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Secretary and other key ministers of Nepal, at separate events.

en.title: Minister of State delivers statement at the High-Level Segment of the 49th Session of the Human Rights Council
en.description: Minister of State delivers statement at the High-Level Segment of the 49th Session of the Human Rights Council
en.body:
Minister of State delivers statement at the High-Level Segment of the 49th Session of the Human Rights Council

Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, His Excellency Ahmed Khaleel today delivered a statement at the High-Level Segment of the ongoing 49th Session of the UN Human Rights Council.

Speaking at the Council, State Minister Khaleel congratulated His Excellency Federico Villegas for being elected as the President of the 49th Session of the Council and assured Maldives’ support during his presidency. Noting that Maldives is on the road to recovery from the COVID-19 pandemic, State Minister stressed the importance of ensuring equitable and affordable access to COVID-19 vaccines to all. He also elaborated on the achievements attained by the Maldives in addressing climate change. In this regard, he recalled that the Maldives was a lead cosponsor of the HRC Resolution 48/13 on the recognition of the right to a clean, healthy and sustainable environment as a human right, for the first time.

He also noted that the Maldives continues to engage with human rights mechanisms on a broader scale and emphasized the importance of promoting diversity and universality in the Council. Furthermore, he reiterated the Maldives’ commitment to working with the voiceless, marginalized and smallest countries to ensure that no one is left behind.

Moreover, the State Minister expressed deep concern on the escalating humanitarian situation in Ukraine and called on all concerned parties to uphold their obligations under international human rights law and humanitarian law.

The High Level Segment was chaired by His Excellency Federico Villegas, President of the 16th cycle of the Human Rights Council.

en.title: The 49th Session of the United Nations Human Rights Council Session begins in Geneva
en.description: Minister of State for Foreign Affairs of Maldives, His Excellency Mr. Ahmed Khaleel will address the High-Level Segment on 2 March 2022.
en.body:
Minister of State for Foreign Affairs of Maldives, His Excellency Mr. Ahmed Khaleel will address the High-Level Segment on 2 March 2022.

28 February 2022, Geneva, Switzerland: The 49th Session of the United Nations Human Rights Council began today in Geneva, Switzerland, opening with a High-Level Segment that will continue from from 28 February to 2 March 2022. This will be followed by the general segment of the 49th Session of the Human Rights Council, from 3 March – 1April 2022.

Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, His Excellency Mr. Ahmed Khaleel will address the High-Level Segment on 2 March 2022. In his statement, State Minister Khaleel will highlight the importance of vaccine equity and provide an update on the work undertaken by the Maldives to address climate change. He will also stress on the importance of diplomacy and dialogue in promoting peace and security throughout the world.

In line with the government’s key policies and priorities, the Maldives’ delegation will deliver national statements under several agenda items. The Maldives will also deliver a joint statement for the High-Level Mainstreaming Panel, on behalf of a group of Small Island Developing States based in Geneva. Maldives, with a cross regional core group, will also put forward a resolution to strengthen the Voluntary Technical Assistance Trust Fund to enhance the participation of Least Developed Countries and Small Island Developing States in the work of the Human Rights Council. At the sidelines of the Human Rights Council, Maldives, together with other members of the Core Group on Human Rights and Environment, will hold a side event on the IPCC 2022 Climate Change Report and its Relationship with the Effective Enjoyment of the Human Right to a Clean, Healthy and Sustainable Environment. During this event, Minister of Environment, Climate Change and Technology, H.E. Ms. Aminath Shauna will deliver special remarks.

The Maldives’ delegation for the High-Level Segment of the 49th Session of the Human Rights Council will be led by Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, H.E. Mr. Ahmed Khaleel. The delegation will also include H.E. Dr. Asim Ahmed, Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary and Permanent Representative of Maldives to the United Nations Office at Geneva, H.E Mr. Ahmed Shiaan, Additional Secretary at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ms. Hawla Ahmed Didi, Deputy Permanent Representative of the Maldives to the United Nations Offices at Geneva, Mr. Hassan Hussain Shihab, Counsellor of the Maldives Mission to the United Nations Offices at Geneva and Mr. Adam Hamid, Director at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

The Maldives has previously served as a Member of the Human Rights Council from 2011 to 2016 for two consecutive terms. The Maldives has now presented its candidature to the Council for the term 2023-2025, the elections for which is scheduled to be held during the 77th Session of the United Nations General Assembly, in October-November 2022, in New York.

The Human Rights Council is an intergovernmental body within the United Nations System, consisting of 47 Member States that are responsible for strengthening the promotion and protection of human rights around the globe.

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Liberation Day greetings to Kuwait
en.description: Minister Shahid sends Liberation Day greetings to Kuwait
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends Liberation Day greetings to Kuwait

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sends a message of felicitations to Foreign Minister and Minister of State for Cabinet Affairs of the State of Kuwait, Sheikh Dr. Ahmad Nasser Al-Mohammad Al-Ahmed Al-Jaber Al-Sabah, on the occasion of the Liberation Day of the State of Kuwait.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“Your Excellency,

It is my pleasure to extend warm felicitations and well wishes to Your Excellency, the Government, and the fraternal people of the State of Kuwait on the occasion of the Liberation Day of Kuwait.

I remain assured that the spirit of close cooperation and collaboration which exists between our two countries will continue to strengthen and expand as we go forward.

Please accept my best wishes for the continued advancement, success, and prosperity for the people of Kuwait.

Please accept, Your Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Greetings to the Foreign Minister of Japan on the Occasion of the Birthday of His Imperial Majesty Emperor Naruhito
en.description: Minister Shahid sends Greetings to the Foreign Minister of Japan on the Occasion of the Birthday of His Imperial Majesty Emperor Naruhito
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends Greetings to the Foreign Minister of Japan on the Occasion of the Birthday of His Imperial Majesty Emperor Naruhito

Minister of Foreign Affairs His Excellency Abdulla Shahid sent a message of felicitations to the Minister for Foreign Affairs of Japan, His Excellency Mr. Hayashi Yoshimasa, on the auspicious occasion of the Birthday of His Imperial Majesty Emperor Naruhito.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“On the auspicious occasion of the Birthday of His Imperial Majesty Emperor Naruhito, I wish to extend warm greetings and sincere good wishes to Your Excellency and the friendly people of Japan.

The Maldives and Japan have a long history of friendship and close cooperation; a resilient partnership that spans over the decades. We are exceedingly appreciative for the generous assistance and support Japan has provided to the people of the Maldives over the years, which is a testament to the strong relations between the two countries. I am confident that the traditional bonds of friendship between our two peoples will continue to strengthen in the years to come, as we strive to improve our collaboration on important areas of mutual interest.

Please accept, Excellency, my best wishes for your success, good health and well-being and for the peace, progress and prosperity of the people of Japan.”

en.title: Minister Shahid sends National Day greetings to Brunei
en.description: Minister Shahid sends National Day greetings to Brunei
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends National Day greetings to Brunei

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, His Excellency Abdulla Shahid sent a message of felicitations to the Minister for Foreign Affairs II of Brunei Darussalam, His Excellency Dato Erywan Yusof on the occasion of the 38th National Day of Brunei Darussalam.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“On behalf of the Government and the people of Maldives, it gives me great pleasure to extend warm felicitations and good wishes to Your Excellency, the Government and the people of Brunei on the auspicious occasion of the 38th National Day of Brunei Darussalam.

Maldives and Brunei enjoy a strong bond of friendship and close bilateral relations based on mutual understanding and trust. I look forward to working closely with Your Excellency in enhancing friendship between our two peoples and promoting cooperation in various fields.

Let me also convey my best wishes for Your Excellency’s good health and well-being, as well as for the continued progress and prosperity for the friendly people of Brunei. Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Founding Day greetings to Saudi Arabia
en.description: Minister Shahid sends Founding Day greetings to Saudi Arabia
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends Founding Day greetings to Saudi Arabia

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sends a message of felicitations to Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, His Royal Highness Prince Faisal bin Farhan Al Saud, on the occasion of the Founding Day of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“Your Royal Highness,

It is my pleasure to extend warm greetings and sincere felicitations to Your Royal Highness, the Government, and the brotherly people of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia on the grand occasion celebrating the first ever Founding Day of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

As Saudi Arabia celebrates this historic day commemorating the founding of the first Saudi State by the pioneering leadership of Imam Muhammad bin Saud, I would like to commend the visionary leaders of the Kingdom for the remarkable progress the country has achieved.

I also take this opportunity to convey my personal good wishes for your good health and well-being, and for the continued happiness, prosperity and advancement of the brotherly people of Saudi Arabia.

Please accept, Your Royal Highness, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day Greetings to the Foreign Minister of Saint Lucia
en.description: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day Greetings to the Foreign Minister of Saint Lucia
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends Independence Day Greetings to the Foreign Minister of Saint Lucia

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sends a message of felicitations to Minister of External Affairs, International Trade, Civil Aviation and Diaspora Affairs of Saint Lucia, Hon. Alva Romanus Baptiste, on the occasion of their 43rd Independence Day.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“On the occasion of your Independence Day, I wish to convey warm felicitations and best wishes, on behalf of the Government, the people of the Republic of Maldives and on my own behalf, to Your Excellency, the Government and the people of Saint Lucia.

I look forward to strengthening the bilateral ties between the two countries, especially increasing our joint action in addressing the special vulnerabilities faced by SIDS in the multilateral system.

Please accept, Excellency, my best wishes for your good health and well-being, and for further progress of the people of Saint Lucia and the assurances of my highest considerations.

en.title: State Minister Khaleel participates in the Ministerial Forum for Cooperation in the Indo-Pacific
en.description: State Minister Khaleel participates in the Ministerial Forum for Cooperation in the Indo-Pacific
en.body:
State Minister Khaleel participates in the Ministerial Forum for Cooperation in the Indo-Pacific

The Minister of State for Foreign Affairs His Excellency Ahmed Khaleel participated today in the Ministerial Forum for Cooperation in the Indo-Pacific, convened jointly by the Government of France and the European Union

During this Forum, State Minister Khaleel delivered his remarks at the roundtable session held under the theme global challenges (health, climate, biodiversity and oceans), and highlighted the unique challenges small island states such as the Maldives face due to the impacts of climate change. State Minister Khaleel further stressed on all countries to make stronger commitments to address climate change related issues and to protect biodiversity and emphasized on the need to adapt to flexible measures and to increase access for small islands states for the required funding related to adaptation and mitigation of climate change.

Moreover, State Minister Khaleel, highlighted Maldives' dynamic relationship with the Indian Ocean and the need to continue expanding resources and strengthen regional and international partnerships, which will aid in building a more secure and prosperous Indian Ocean Region.

Co-Chaired by the Minister of Foreign Affairs of New Zealand Nanaia Mahuta and Executive Vice President of the European Commission for the Green Deal, Frans Timmermans, the roundtable was also attended by Foreign Ministers of Indo Pacific countries.

State Minister Khaleel was accompanied by Non Resident Ambassador of Maldives to France Dr. Farahanaz Faizal and Executive Director at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Fathimath Naeema.

The Indo Pacific Ministerial Forum, is the first of its kind held as part of the Programmes of French Presidency of the Council of the European Union and provided an opportunity for Foreign Ministers, representatives, and heads of delegation from the countries of the Indo pacific region for dialogue and discussions. The Forum focused on issues ranging from connectivity, security and defence and global challenges such as climate, biodiversity, health and oceans.

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to The Gambia
en.description: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to The Gambia
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to The Gambia

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sends a message of felicitations to the Minister of Foreign Affairs, International Cooperation and Gambians Abroad, Dr. Mamadou Tangara, on the occasion of the Independence Day of the Republic of The Gambia.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“Excellency,

Let me extend sincere greetings and good wishes to Your Excellency, the Government and the people of The Gambia, on the joyous occasion of your Independence Day.

I am confident that the bilateral ties of friendship between our two countries will continue to develop and flourish in the years ahead.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

en.title: Minister of State for South and Central Asia, UN and the Commonwealth, and Prime Minister’s Special Representative for Preventing Sexual Violence in Conflict of the United Kingdom arrives in the Maldives
en.description: Lord (Tariq) Ahmad of Wimbledon, of the United Kingdom arrived in the Maldives on an official visit
en.body:
Lord (Tariq) Ahmad of Wimbledon, of the United Kingdom arrived in the Maldives on an official visit

Minister of State for South and Central Asia, UN and the Commonwealth, and Prime Minister’s Special Representative for Preventing Sexual Violence in Conflict of the United Kingdom, Lord (Tariq) Ahmad of Wimbledon, arrived in the Maldives this morning on an official visit.

Lord Ahmad was received at the Velana International Airport by Minister of State for Foreign Affairs Ahmed Khaleel and senior officials from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

This visit marks the first high level visit to the Maldives from the United Kingdom since 2018.

en.title: Minister of State for South and Central Asia, UN and the Commonwealth, and Prime Minister’s Special Representative for Preventing Sexual Violence in Conflict of the United Kingdom meets with Minister of State for Foreign Affairs
en.description: Minister of State for South and Central Asia, UN and the Commonwealth, and Prime Minister’s Special Representative for Preventing Sexual Violence in Conflict of
en.body:
Minister of State for South and Central Asia, UN and the Commonwealth, and Prime Minister’s Special Representative for Preventing Sexual Violence in Conflict of

The Minister of State for Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Ahmed Khaleel, and the Minister of State for South and Central Asia, UN and the Commonwealth, and Prime Minister’s Special Representative for Preventing Sexual Violence in Conflict of the United Kingdom Lord (Tariq) Ahmad of Wimbledon, held bilateral talks at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, today.

During the meeting held this morning, State Minister Khaleel welcomed Lord Ahmad to the Ministry and reiterated Maldives commitment to working closely with the United Kingdom on issues of mutual interests for both countries. Both State Minister Khaleel and Lord Ahmad further discussed avenues of cooperation in the areas of higher education, counter-terrorism, defence, environment and climate change, tourism and fisheries including eliminating tariffs for Maldivian Tuna exports to the United Kingdom. Both State Ministers also reaffirmed their commitment to enhance cooperation in the international arena, especially through the Commonwealth.

Lord Ahmad will make courtesy calls on the Speaker of the People’s Majlis, President Mohamed Nasheed and also attend the Official Opening Ceremony of the British High Commission in Male’ later today.

The State Minister was accompanied at the meeting by Foreign Secretary, Abdul Ghafoor Mohamed, Secretary Multilateral Dr. Hala Hameed and senior officials of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

en.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs launched the first Session of Information Series “Promoting Sustainable Economic Growth in Maldives”
en.description: Ministry of Foreign Affairs launched the first Session of Information Series “Promoting Sustainable Economic Growth in Maldives”
en.body:
Ministry of Foreign Affairs launched the first Session of Information Series “Promoting Sustainable Economic Growth in Maldives”

The Economic Cooperation Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in coordination with the Foreign Service Institute of Maldives, held the first Session of the Information Series titled “Promoting Sustainable Economic Growth in Maldives” today.

The session held virtually aimed for High Commissioners and Ambassadors accredited to Maldives, as well as for resident missions in Maldives will act as a platform to understand the current economic situation and investment priorities of the Maldives, enabling further collaboration between Maldives and its bilateral partners.

Opening remarks at the session was delivered by His Excellency Ahmed Khaleel, Minister of State for Foreign Affairs. During his opening remarks, State Minister Khaleel highlighted on the priorities of the Government, and provided an update on the economic progress the Maldives has achieved since the pandemic. State Minister Khaleel also expressed his appreciation for the generous assistance and support from the bilateral and multilateral partners especially during the economic down turn due to the Covid-19 Pandemic.

The Series is being held in collaboration with Ministry of Economic Development, Ministry of Tourism, Ministry of Fisheries, Marine Resources and Agriculture, Ministry of Environment, Climate Change and Technology, Maldives Marketing and Public Relations Corporation and Housing Development Cooperation and will be held on 15 February 2022, and 22 February 2022 respectively.

The Information Series welcomed over 80 participants, including 37 Ambassadors and High Commissioners accredited to the Maldives and other UN representatives accredited to the Maldives at the session held today.

en.title: Defence Secretary of India, calls on Minister of State for Foreign Affairs
en.description: Defence Secretary of India, calls on Minister of State for Foreign Affairs
en.body:
Defence Secretary of India, calls on Minister of State for Foreign Affairs

Defence Secretary of India, Dr. Ajay Kumar, called on the Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Ahmed Khaleel today. The meeting was held at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

During the meeting, State Minister welcomed Defence Secretary Dr. Ajay Kumar to the Maldives and reviewed the recent developments in India-Maldives relations particularly in the field of Defence and Security cooperation. State Minister also highlighted the continuous contribution by the Government of India towards enhancing the capacity and readiness of the Maldives National Defence Force. The State Minister and Defence Secretary reaffirmed the commitment to further strengthen the strategic cooperation between both countries, particularly to ensure peace and security in the Indian Ocean region.

The State Minister was accompanied at the meeting by Foreign Secretary, Abdul Ghafoor Mohamed and senior officials of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Maldives.

en.body:
Lord (Tariq) Ahmad of Wimbledon, Minister of State for South and Central Asia, UN and the Commonwealth of the United Kingdom to make an official visit

en.title: Secretary-General of the Muslim World League concludes official visit to the Maldives
en.description: Secretary-General of the Muslim World League concludes official visit to the Maldives
en.body:
Secretary-General of the Muslim World League concludes official visit to the Maldives

The Secretary-General of the Muslim World League, His Excellency Sheikh Dr. Mohammad bin Abdulkarim Al-Issa has concluded his official visit to the Maldives.

The Secretary-General was seen-off at the Velana International Airport by His Excellency Ahmed Khaleel, Minister of State for Foreign Affairs and senior officials of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

During his visit, Secretary-General Dr. Al-Issa called on His Excellency Ibrahim Mohamed Solih, President of the Maldives, Her Excellency Uza. Mariya Ahmed Didi, Minister of Defence, His Excellency Dr. Ahmed Zahir, Minister of Islamic Affairs, and His Excellency Ahmed Khaleel, Minister of State for Foreign Affairs. During the visit, the first official talks between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Muslim World League was also held, to strengthen cooperation on a wide range of areas, including establishing a Muslim World League regional office in the Maldives.

This was the first official visit by a Secretary-General of the Muslim World League to the Maldives.

en.title: Foreign Secretary virtually participates in the Ministerial Meeting of the Media Freedom Coalition and the Third Global Conference for Media Freedom
en.description: Foreign Secretary virtually participates in the Ministerial Meeting of the Media Freedom Coalition and the Third Global Conference for Media Freedom
en.body:
Foreign Secretary virtually participates in the Ministerial Meeting of the Media Freedom Coalition and the Third Global Conference for Media Freedom

Foreign Secretary, His Excellency Abdul Ghafoor Mohamed today participated in the Ministerial Meeting of the Media Freedom Coalition (MFC) and the Third Global Conference for Media Freedom. The hybrid meeting was hosted by the Government of Estonia and the Estonian Human Rights Institute.

Speaking at the Ministerial Meeting, Foreign Secretary stressed on the importance of raising voices for the protection of journalists who risk their lives to keep the public informed. He also recalled the steps taken by the Government to defend media freedom in the domestic sphere, and highlighted that the Maldives has been rising through the ranks of the World Press Freedom Index under the current administration.

Foreign Secretary applauded the work being undertaken by the Coalition to guarantee media freedom and the safety of journalists worldwide, such as in Myanmar and Afghanistan. He then called on all member states to work closely to combat all forms of threats to independent media. He further pledged continued integrity and dedication of the Maldives to strengthen response to attacks on media freedom, both online and offline. He concluded his remarks by reiterating the commitment of the Maldives to work together with the Coalition, the United Nations and other international organizations, as well as the civil society, to protect and to promote press freedom and the rights of the journalists everywhere.

The MFC was formed in July 2019 at the Global Conference for Media Freedom. The Coalition is a partnership of countries working together to advocate for media freedom and safety of journalists worldwide and hold to account those who harm media workers for doing their job. Maldives became a member of the MFC on 11 July 2019 and is a member of the Coalition’s Executive Group.

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to the Foreign Minister of Grenada
en.description: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to the Foreign Minister of Grenada
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to the Foreign Minister of Grenada

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sends message of felicitations to Oliver Joseph, Minister of Foreign Affairs, International Business and CARICOM Affairs of Grenada, on the occasion of their Independence Day.

As two Small Island Developing States, I hope to continue our collaboration to address the unique challenges we face, particularly on climate change.

Please accept, Excellency, my best wishes for your good health and well-being, and for further progress and welfare of the people of Grenada.”

en.title: Visa-free access to be granted for Indian Nationals arriving in the Maldives for business purposes
en.description: Visa-free access to be granted for Indian Nationals arriving in the Maldives for business purposes
en.body:
Visa-free access to be granted for Indian Nationals arriving in the Maldives for business purposes

Effective from 1 February 2022, the Government of Maldives has initiated the process of granting Indian Nationals visa free entry for business purposes, for a period not exceeding the visa free period of 90 days, stipulated in the Agreement on the Facilitation of Visa Arrangements between the Government of Maldives and the Government of India signed on 17 December 2018.

As part of the reciprocal arrangement, a multiple entry, non-resident, business visa shall be granted for Indian Nationals for a period of 90 days within 6 months. Any Indian National with an approved business visa is eligible to renew their visa up to 180 days within a calendar year. This is in addition to the visa free period of 90 days stipulated in the bilateral agreement.

Business visa application shall be lodged with the Ministry of Economic Development through https://business.egov.mv/GeneralServiceRequests prior to expiry of visa free entry period. Business visa shall be renewed prior to expiry of an existing approval. An employment approval shall be obtained by any Indian National holding a business visa whose allowable business visa stay exceeds 180 days within a calendar year.

en.title: Secretary-General of the Muslim World League arrives in the Maldives on an official visit
en.description: Secretary-General of the Muslim World League arrives in the Maldives on an official visit
en.body:
Secretary-General of the Muslim World League arrives in the Maldives on an official visit

The Secretary-General of the Muslim World League, His Excellency Sheikh Dr. Mohammad bin Abdulkarim Al-Issa has arrived in the Maldives this evening, on an official visit, upon the invitation of His Excellency Ibrahim Mohamed Solih, President of the Maldives.

Secretary-General Sheikh Dr. Al-Issa was received at the Velana International Airport by His Excellency Ahmed Khaleel, Minister of State for Foreign Affairs and senior officials of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

During his visit, Secretary-General Sheikh Dr. Al-Issa will call on President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih, His Excellency Dr. Ahmed Zahir, Minister of Islamic Affairs and Her Excellency Uza. Mariya Ahmed Didi, Minister of Defence. He will also meet with the Minister of State for Foreign Affairs.

The Muslim World League (MWL), also known as the Rabitat al-Alam al-Islami, is an international Non-Governmental Organization established in 1962, which strives to clarify to the world, the true and moderate principles of Islam. The MWL is based in the Holy City of Makkah, Saudi Arabia.

en.title: Foreign Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Foreign Minister of Sri Lanka
en.description: Foreign Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Foreign Minister of Sri Lanka
en.body:
Foreign Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Foreign Minister of Sri Lanka

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sends a message of felicitations to Professor Gamini Lakshman Peiris, Minister for Foreign Affairs of Sri Lanka, on the occasion of Sri Lanka’s Seventy Fourth Independence Day.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“On behalf of the Government, the people of the Republic of Maldives and on my own behalf, I would like to extend warm greetings and sincere good wishes on the occasion of the Seventy Fourth Independence Day of Sri Lanka.

  The Maldives and Sri Lanka continue to enjoy close neighborly relations based on mutual trust, understanding and goodwill. I remain confident that the time - tested relations of friendship and cooperation between our two countries will further broaden and strengthen in the years to come.

May I also take this opportunity to convey my personal good wishes for your good health and well-being, and for the continued progress and prosperity of the friendly people of Sri Lanka.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

en.title: Memorandum of Understanding Signed between the Permanent Mission of Maldives and UNITAR
en.description: MoU signed between Maldives and UNITAR
en.body:
MoU signed between Maldives and UNITAR

3 February 2022, Geneva, Switzerland

A Memorandum of Understanding has been signed today between the Permanent Mission of the Republic of Maldives to the United Nations and Other International Organizations in Geneva and the United Nations Institute for Training and Research (UNITAR), at a ceremony held at the UNITAR Office in Geneva this afternoon.

The agreement signed today focuses on two main thematic areas, namely Diplomatic training skills development, and Climate Change Resilience, Disaster Management and Development using geospatial information technologies.

Diplomatic training would greatly contribute to the further development of the Maldives foreign service cadre, which is essential to effectively pursue the foreign policy objectives. The use of geospatial information technologies provides an innovative and effective tool to understand and address the challenges of climate change and environmental vulnerability.

The Memorandum of Understanding was signed by H.E. Dr Asim Ahmed, Permanent Representative of Maldives to the United Nations Office at Geneva, on behalf of the government of Maldives and Mr Nikhil Seth, Assistant Secretary-General of the United Nations and Executive Director on behalf of UNITAR.

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Chinese New Year Greetings to China
en.description: Minister Shahid sends Chinese New Year Greetings to China
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends Chinese New Year Greetings to China

Minister of Foreign Affairs of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sent Chinese New Year Greetings to His Excellency Wang Yi, State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs of the People’s Republic of China, on the occassion of the Chinese New Year, the Year of the Tiger.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“On this auspicious occasion of the Chinese Spring Festival and the New Year of the Tiger, I would like to extend warm felicitations and sincere good wishes to Your Excellency, the Government, and the friendly people of China.   I also see this as an exceptional occasion to express my sincere appreciation and gratitude for the close cooperation and continued support extended by the Government of the People’s Republic of China to the Maldives at all times, especially during the most challenging times of COVID-19. I am confident that the close ties of friendship and partnership between our two countries will thrive and further strengthen during this auspicious Year of the Tiger, which symbolizes strength, power and prosperity.   Excellency, I look forward to attending the Opening Ceremony of the 2022 Winter Olympics to be held in Beijing. I wish Your Excellency, the Government, and the friendly people of China all the best for a successful Winter Olympics.   Let me also convey my personal best wishes for Your Excellency’s good health, success, continued peace, progress and prosperity for the people of China.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

en.title: Ambassador of Japan to the Maldives calls on Minister of Foreign Affairs
en.description: Ambassador of Japan to the Maldives calls on Minister of Foreign Affairs
en.body:
Ambassador of Japan to the Maldives calls on Minister of Foreign Affairs

The new Ambassador of Japan to the Maldives, Her Excellency Takeuchi Midori called on the Minister of Foreign Affairs His Excellency Abdulla Shahid, today. Ambassador Takechi presented her credentials to President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih at a ceremony held at the President’s Office on 20 January 2022.

At the meeting held at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs this afternoon, Foreign Minister Shahid congratulated and welcomed the Ambassador and expressed appreciation for the continued cooperation and solidarity between the two countries.

Highlighting the close partnership and friendship between the two nations, Minister Shahid thanked Japan for being a close friend and ally of the Maldives, especially for the support extended to the Maldives during the ongoing Covid-19 pandemic.

Ambassador Takeuchi thanked Minister for the warm welcome, and conveyed her commitment to working closely with the Government and people of the Maldives in continuing the efforts to enhance the bilateral relation between both countries in areas of mutual interest. Both the Minister and Ambassador concurred to cooperate towards further consolidation of ties, as 2022 marks the 55th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between Maldives and Japan.

Minister was accompanied by Abdul Ghafoor Mohamed, Foreign Secretary and Mohamed Shujau, Desk Officer at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

en.title: High Commissioner of Bangladesh pays farewell call on the Foreign Minister
en.description: High Commissioner of Bangladesh pays farewell call on the Foreign Minister
en.body:
High Commissioner of Bangladesh pays farewell call on the Foreign Minister

High Commissioner of the People’s Republic of Bangladesh His Excellency Mohammed Nazmul Hassan made a farewell call on the Minister of Foreign Affairs His Excellency Abdulla Shahid this afternoon at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

During the farewell call, Foreign Minister Shahid conveyed his sincere gratitude and appreciation to the High Commissioner for his strong commitment and contribution to revive and strengthen the bilateral relationship and cooperation between the two countries as well as for the kind and generous support Bangladesh has extended towards the Maldives over the past years.

High Commissioner reciprocated by stating that his tenure in the Maldives has been memorable and rewarding, having witnessed the exchange of a number of high level visits between the two countries as well as the conclusion of key agreements on cooperation particularly in the area of trade, health and youth and sports.

Foreign Minister and High Commissioner during their discussions reflected on the recent successful State Visit by the Prime Minister of Bangladesh to the Maldives in December 2021 and the State Visit of President of Maldives to Bangladesh in March 2021, which opened up new horizons in the bilateral chapter between the two countries.

High Commissioner expressed his sentiments, for the support and cooperation extended to him during his tenure in the Maldives, and expressed his sincere hope that the relationship between the two countries will enhance in the future.

Foreign Minister wished High Commissioner the best in his future endeavors.

Foreign Minister Shahid was accompanied by Foreign Secretary Abdul Ghafoor Mohamed and Joint Secretary Khadeeja Najeeha at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

en.title: New High Commissioner of Sri Lanka to Maldives Calls on Minister of Foreign Affairs
en.description: New High Commissioner of Sri Lanka to Maldives Calls on Minister of Foreign Affairs
en.body:
New High Commissioner of Sri Lanka to Maldives Calls on Minister of Foreign Affairs

High Commissioner of Sri Lanka to Maldives, Adam Maznavee Jaufer Sadiq paid a courtesy call on the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Abdulla Shahid, today.

During the meeting held at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Minister Shahid congratulated the High Commissioner on presenting his credentials, and expressed confidence that the relations between the two countries will be further reinvigorated during his tenure.

Foreign Minister Shahid stated that as a close and historical partner, the Maldives attaches great importance to its relations with Sri Lanka and appreciates the past and continued assistance provided by Sri Lanka towards the socio economic development of Maldives. Foreign Minister further thanked the Government of Sri Lanka for the hospitality accorded to the large number of Maldivians residing in Sri Lanka.

Foreign Minister and High Commissioner also discussed ways to further strengthen the existing friendly relations with particular focus given to enhancing cooperation in trade, health and education sectors.

High Commissioner Sadiq thanked the Minister for the warm welcome, and conveyed his strong commitment to working closely with the Government and people of the Maldives to further enhance the existing bilateral relations between the two countries in areas of mutual interest.

Foreign Minister Shahid was accompanied by Foreign Secretary Abdul Ghafoor Mohamed and Joint Secretary, Khadeeja Najeeha at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Nauru
en.description: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Nauru
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Nauru

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sends message of felicitations to Lionel Rouwen Aingimea, MP, Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Nauru, on the occasion of their Independence Day.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“On behalf of the Government, the people of the Republic of Maldives and on my own behalf, it gives me great pleasure to extend warm greetings and felicitations to Your Excellency, the Government and the people of Nauru, on the occasion of your 54th Independence Day.

As fellow SIDS, I look forward to enhancing cooperation between our two countries at the bilateral and multilateral front.

Please accept, Excellency, my best wishes for your good health and happiness, and for continued peace, progress and prosperity of people of Nauru.”

en.title: Foreign Ministers of Maldives and Türkiye holds Official talks
en.description: Foreign Ministers of Maldives and Türkiye holds Official talks
en.body:
Foreign Ministers of Maldives and Türkiye holds Official talks

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid, and the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Türkiye, Mevlüt Çavuşoğlu, held official talks at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, today.

During the discussions between the two Ministers, Minister Çavuşoğlu accepted the proposal by Minister Shahid to establish a visa-free regime between Maldives and Türkiye. This will allow Maldivians to travel to Turkiye without obtaining prior visa, and increase people-to-people contact between the Maldives and Turkiye.

Both Minister Shahid and Minister Çavuşoğlu discussed a wide array of issues of mutual interest in the areas of education, youth and sports, health, tourism, fisheries and agriculture, environment and climate change, economic cooperation, and counter-terrorism and de-radicalisation. The Ministers also reaffirmed their commitment to enhance cooperation in the international arena, particularly in addressing the contemporary challenges of the Muslim word.

Minister Çavuşoğlu committed the support of Türkiye for the Maldives candidature for the United Nations Human Rights Council for the term 2023-2025. Minister Shahid also conveyed the support of the Government of Maldives to Türkiye’s bid to host the 51st Session of the Council of Foreign Ministers of the Organisation for Islamic Conference in 2025.

en.title: Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Türkiye concludes Official visit to the Maldives
en.description: Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Türkiye concludes Official visit to the Maldives
en.body:
Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Türkiye concludes Official visit to the Maldives

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Türkiye, Mevlüt Çavuşoğlu has concluded his Official visit to the Maldives.

Minister Çavuşoğlu was seen-off at the Velana International Airport by Minister Shahid and senior officials from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

During his visit, Minister Çavuşoğlu and Minister Shahid witnessed the conclusion of 5 key agreements between the Maldives and Türkiye, in the areas of trade and economic cooperation, agriculture, culture and cooperation between the Foreign Service Institute of Maldives and the Diplomacy Academy of Türkiye.

Minister Çavuşoğlu also paid a courtesy call on President of the Republic of Maldives, Ibrahim Mohamed Solih, and the Speaker of the People's Majlis, President Mohamed Nasheed.

This was the first Official visit by a Foreign Minister from the Republic of Türkiye to the Maldives.
